title: Fairer Preferences Elicit Improved Human-Aligned Large Language Model Judgments

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the absolute difference between the model's predictive preference distribution (decision rate for each class) and a uniform prior distribution over a dataset of pairwise text comparisons to detect unfair skew.

Implementing a permutation debiasing method (Balanced Position Calibration) that averages the prediction probabilities for different orders/positions of the same candidates to evaluate and mitigate positional preference.
Generating a set of semantically equivalent paraphrased instructions and measuring the variance and fluctuation in the model's pairwise preference distributions and human agreement scores.
